description.raw: '''Passive:''' ''[[File:Orianna Clockwork Windup.png|20xpx|border|link=Orianna#Clockwork Windup|An icon for Orianna's ability Clockwork Windup]] [[Orianna#Clockwork Windup|The Ball]]'' grants [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]]  '''bonus''' armor and [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance to the unit it is attached to.
description.text: Passive: The Ball grants   bonus armor and  bonus magic resistance to the unit it is attached to.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Orianna''' commands ''The Ball'' to fly to herself or the target allied [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] and attach itself to the target, dealing magic damage to enemies it passes through and granting the target a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 2.5 seconds upon arrival.
description2.text: Active: Orianna commands The Ball to fly to herself or the target allied champion and attach itself to the target, dealing magic damage to enemies it passes through and granting the target a shield for 2.5 seconds upon arrival.

leveling2.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 (+ 30% AP)
'''Shield Strength:'''
55 / 90 / 125 / 160 / 195 (+ 45% AP)

notes.raw: * ''The Ball'' does not grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] while in flight, but the sound effect of striking an enemy is audible through the Fog of War. * '''Orianna''' cannot cast her other abilities while the ''The Ball'' is moving to the target with ''Command: Protect''. * '''Orianna''' gains ''Command: Protect's'' bonus resistances whenever ''The Ball'' is attached to her (even if she didn't self-cast). * ''The Ball'' will remain where ''Command: Protect's'' target ally [[death|died]] or, if they died or became [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] before The Ball reaches them, it will instead snap back to '''Orianna'''. ** ''The Ball'' will return to '''Orianna''' if ''Command: Protect's'' target ally moves too far away from her (''The Ball'' will always respect its [[Pets#Leash range|leash range]], which is increased by 100 when attached to allied champions). * ''The Ball'' will join ''Command: Protect's'' target ally in [[File:Guerrilla Warfare.png|20px|link=Stealth|An icon representing the keyword Stealth]] [[:Stealth|stealth]] if they are affected by it when '''Orianna''' targets them. * ''The Ball'' snaps back to '''Orianna''' upon being intercepted by [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectile-blocking]] effects. * ''Command: Protect'' has a [[File:Targeting forgiveness.svg|20px|link=Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|An icon representing the keyword Targeting forgiveness]] [[:Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|forgiveness radius]] of 175 units.
notes.text:
The Ball does not grant sight while in flight, but the sound effect of striking an enemy is audible through the Fog of War.
Orianna cannot cast her other abilities while the The Ball is moving to the target with Command: Protect.
Orianna gains Command: Protect's bonus resistances whenever The Ball is attached to her (even if she didn't self-cast).
The Ball will remain where Command: Protect's target ally died or, if they died or became untargetable before The Ball reaches them, it will instead snap back to Orianna.
* The Ball will return to Orianna if Command: Protect's target ally moves too far away from her (The Ball will always respect its leash range, which is increased by 100 when attached to allied champions).
The Ball will join Command: Protect's target ally in stealth if they are affected by it when Orianna targets them.
The Ball snaps back to Orianna upon being intercepted by projectile-blocking effects.
Command: Protect has a forgiveness radius of 175 units.
